mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, parent_id, role, content, status, model_id, thinking_enabled, token_usage, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, conversation_id, parent_id, role, content, status, model_id, thinking_enabled, token_usage, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, conversation_id, parent_id, role, content, status, model_id, thinking_enabled, token_usage, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at FROM message WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, conversation_id, parent_id, role, content, status, model_id, thinking_enabled, token_usage, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
